name: US equity stress
summary: VIX near 21 and Nasdaq 100 in correction as AI-spending doubts hit tech shares
state: The VIX was about 20.8 on 3 Nov, above the 20 Watch line, and the S&P 500 is about 3.2% below its high. On 2 Nov the Nasdaq 100 fell 1.4% into correction territory on doubts about returns on AI spending, while the S&P 500 lost 0.5% (Saxo). US midterms (3 Nov), the Bank of England (5 Nov) and payrolls (6 Nov) fall this week.
for_you: Pension and investment values linked to US technology shares are swinging more than usual; volatility tends to stay elevated around elections and central-bank decisions.
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
